description.narrative: The Project Development Objective (PDO) is to improve maritime transport resilience, connectivity and safety between the islands.

The development objective of the Comoros - Interisland Connectivity Project SOP2 is to improve maritime transport resilience, connectivity and safety between the islands. The project will consist of the following components: Component 1. Improvement of Climate Resilience and Capacity of Port Infrastructure (US$28 million from AfDB and US$5 million from IsDB); Component 2. Maritime safety and safe passenger boat program (US$3 million IDA equivalent; US$10 million from IsDB); Component 3. Implementation support and capacity building (US$2 million IDA equivalent); and Component 4: Contingent emergency response (US$0 million).
